_comment: Seed services and demo incidents. Every repo was verified on 2026-08-16 to ship package-lock.json lockfileVersion 3 with real commit history; 172 transitive deps are shared by all eight. Disclosed per Track 02 rules (bring-your-own dataset).

snapshots._comment: Lockfile snapshots per service: the last commit touching package-lock.json at or before each cutoff, plus dense hourly-resolution samples around each incident window so Q3 has lockfiles inside/before/after the window.

incidents.name: TanStack worm (Mini Shai-Hulud)
incidents.note: 42 packages, 84 versions, 5m39s publish window, advisory 4h52m later. Largest multi-package npm advisory in OSV. Primary demo.

incidents.name: chalk / debug / ansi-styles compromise
incidents.note: No umbrella advisory; MAL-2025-4696x..4698x per package. 806k dependents on debug alone. Second demo — the blast radius that does not fit on screen.

typosquat_corpus._comment: NAME_SIMILAR_TO is materialised over the top-N packages by downloads plus every package name touched by ingest.
